name: roughcut
description: First-draft video editor driven by your Claude agent. Bundles whisper-small for offline first-run transcription. Doc/interview and multicam podcast modes. Long-running work runs as background jobs that survive Claude Desktop restarts.
long_description: Point roughcut at a folder of interview footage and a folder of b-roll. The agent picks the cleanest takes, decides where b-roll fits, and writes a Premiere / DaVinci Resolve project file. roughcut does the deterministic work (transcribe, cluster takes, contact-sheet frames, build FCPXML); your Claude subscription pays for the reasoning. macOS Apple Silicon only.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: Inventory video files in a folder via ffprobe (sync).

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Spawn an mlx-whisper transcription job; returns job_id. Default model: whisper-small (bundled).

tools.name: prewarm_model
tools.description: Pre-download a larger whisper model in the background.

tools.name: cluster_takes_by_silence
tools.description: Spawn a silence-clustering job; returns job_id.

tools.name: align_takes_to_script
tools.description: Spawn a script-alignment job; returns job_id.

tools.name: extract_frame_grid
tools.description: Sample frames from a clip into a contact sheet (sync).

tools.name: get_clip_thumbnail
tools.description: Extract one frame at a specific timecode (sync).

tools.name: generate_fcpxml
tools.description: Write FCPXML 1.10 + FCP 7 XML + EDL + reel relink CSV from one SequenceSpec; self-validates before returning success (sync).

tools.name: validate_fcpxml
tools.description: Re-validate an FCPXML file (well-formedness + ref/id graph + optional xmllint DTD check).

tools.name: restart_workers
tools.description: Self-heal: kill all workers + respawn (sync).

tools.name: get_server_logs
tools.description: Tail recent watchdog + worker logs for self-diagnosis (sync).

tools.name: lookup_transcript_by_video_path
tools.description: Find a cached transcript JSON by its source video path (sync).

tools.name: detect_multicam_groups
tools.description: Spawn an audio-sync grouping job; returns job_id.

tools.name: diarize_speakers
tools.description: Spawn a mic-RMS diarization job; returns job_id.

tools.name: pick_angle_per_segment
tools.description: Spawn an angle-picking job; returns job_id.

tools.name: generate_multicam_fcpxml
tools.description: Write FCPXML from an AngleSelection list (sync).

tools.name: check_job_status
tools.description: Poll an async job by job_id.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent jobs (use to recover after a Claude Desktop restart).

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Stop a running job (SIGTERM then SIGKILL).

tools.name: resume_job
tools.description: Re-run a failed / interrupted / cancelled job.

tools.name: get_project_paths
tools.description: Return the user-configured interview, b-roll, and script paths.

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.description: Preflight diagnostics + worker pool config + queue depth.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Page through a saved transcript JSON in chunks (sync, docs mode).

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search across cached transcripts (sync).

tools.name: summarize_clip
tools.description: Deterministic snippet view of one clip's transcript (sync).

interview_folder.title: Interview footage folder
interview_folder.description: Folder containing your sit-down / talking-head clips. Used by the get_project_paths tool so the agent doesn't have to ask each session.

broll_folder.title: B-roll folder
broll_folder.description: Folder containing supporting visuals (cutaways, archival footage). Optional.

script_path.title: Script (.txt or .md)
script_path.description: Plain-text script the agent will align takes against. Skip if you have no script — the agent will cluster by silence instead.
